verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an official "WorkOS CLI migrations tool" as the fastest way to export Auth0 data, which produces a migration package of users, orgs, memberships, roles and SSO handoff files. That confirms a first-party CLI exists, but its evidenced scope is limited to migrations. CLI Auth (the device-flow feature) is a building block for customers' own CLIs and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of general workspace management from the CLI, installation/command reference docs, AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
